lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Reward: Energy Drink ×2

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I've received the parts.
Are they what you are looking for?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I was worried that they might be too outdated, but they seem to work perfectly.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Thank you for getting them to us safely.
I'm just wondering...

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Yes?
You mentioned that they are used to treat humans?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Yes.
Isn't the Ark's medical technology second-to-none?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Yes, and?
What do you still need these Nikke parts for, then?

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I thought you might just ask that.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Can you keep this between us?
My lips are sealed.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Sure, Ark's medical tech may be spectacular, as you said.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Not only that, but we can also utilize cell regeneration technology quite easily.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: However, it is incredibly time-consuming and costly.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: What's more, the Repair Center is always under the watchful eye of the Central Government.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: If I wish to provide medical assistance to people in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I'd have to stay far away from the government's prying eyes.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Out of sight, out of mind.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Every month, I offer Nikke-parts transplants to people who would be immobile otherwise.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: As for these second-generation parts, they don't put too much stress on the body.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: That's why it's easy for anyone to deal with, be it technological handling or cost.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: It's just that we ran out of parts when we received that last request.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: So I came to request for your assistance.
That's fair enough.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: I hope that answers any questions you have.

lines.speaker: justin
lines.text: Once again, thank you very much for your help.
